title: Status Code Tally
story: The load balancer logs one request per line: METHOD PATH STATUS. Management wants a count per status code.
goal: Write status_counts(lines): return a dict mapping each status code (as text) to how many times it appears.
hints: split() turns a line into words. Which word holds the status?
socratic: What do you do the first time you see a code?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Status Code Tally”?
